programs.title: Japan on a plate
programs.desc: Alexa Łuczak moved to the Land of the Rising Sun over ten years ago.During this time, she mastered the language on her own, which allowed her to host one of the local television programs.The model decided to share her knowledge about extraordinary Asian cuisine.Her search for local flavors will take her to small bars hidden in the city's alleys, to the largest fish market in Japan and to the establishments of the most talented sushi masters.The host will also visit elegant restaurants in Tokyo.There is no shortage of vending machines and fresh seafood in this city.Viewers will also learn more about Japan itself, its traditions and culture.
